gpt.text:
Run the three “Next Commands” in order; they cover (1) module-level sweep with best-selection, (2) system-level candidate sweep, and (3) generating a targeted “next fix” report from the registry/results.

## 1) Module autopilot (select best)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
What to look for:
- It should evaluate module candidates against the current champion (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`).
- With `--select-best`, it typically updates the “current champion” pointer/artifact if a candidate beats the champion by the selection criterion (mean/min thresholds depending on your framework).

After it finishes, confirm:
- A new PASS candidate exists (or champion updated).
- The produced report/log indicates the winning module(s) and deltas vs champion.

## 2) System autopilot (system candidate sweep)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What to look for:
- Any system-level candidate that improves over the champion metrics (tuning + lockbox).
- Pay special attention to **lockbox_min** (often the “don’t regress worst-case” guardrail). Your champion lockbox_min is `1.1337`; if a candidate raises mean but drops min materially, it may be rejected depending on your policy.

## 3) Generate “next fix” report (actionable TODOs)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
What you should get:
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` summarizing the highest-value fixes (e.g., failing modules, flaky evals, missing configs, weak candidates) based on the most recent runs.

## If anything fails
Send back:
- The console error + last ~50 lines of logs
- The updated directory listing for `baseline/` (especially reports/results)
- Whether the champion file changed and any newly created candidate JSONs

## Minimal post-run checklist
- Confirm whether `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` changed (or a new champion file was written).
- Record the best candidate’s tuning_mean/min and lockbox_mean/min.
- Save/commit updated reports under `baseline/reports/` (including `next_fix.md`).
